articles.headline: Eight blanks are not eight green lights
articles.dek: Undertow has 112 published measures across nine market segments. Only investment-grade credit currently earns a public tier. The other eight say PARTIAL because history or replay evidence is incomplete, not because those markets are calm.

original_contribution.statement: An evidence-gate audit showing why measure count alone cannot authorize a market-liquidity tier.

limitations: Undertow replays use truncated current-vintage observations restricted by dated knowability, not publication-vintage validated backtests. PARTIAL does not imply illiquidity, and NORMAL does not guarantee executable depth.
